hints.title: Local Inversion Inherent Subset
hints.text: Every local inversion is inherently a global inversion.

hints.title: Exclusion of Non-Local Inversions
hints.text: The two inversion counts can only match if there exist zero non-local inversions.

hints.title: Index Displacement Check
hints.text: A non-local inversion occurs whenever an element moves two or more positions away from its sorted index. Verify that the absolute difference between each value and its index is at most one.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of permutation array nums
complexity.notes: Single pass checking index distance per element.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Counting all global inversions with Fenwick or merge sort takes O(N log N) time and extra space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant O(1) space with no modifications to input.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduce that ideal permutations only permit swapping adjacent pairs, so |nums[i] - i| <= 1.
